videos.description: It's the Outsiders' first day in the wild. A sceptical David Mitchell oversees the chaos as the teams are set survival challenges and compete for badges.

videos.title: Outsiders
videos.description: David Mitchell oversees events as the pairs try to demonstrate various skills in barbering, milking goats and inventing alternative uses for a condom.

videos.title: Outsiders
videos.description: David Mitchell oversees the pairs of comedians as they attempt to show they can camouflage themselves, invent a camp anthem and design a flag.

videos.title: Outsiders
videos.description: David is equipped with a hosepipe as he tests out whether the shelters he's asked the comedians to build are waterproof or not, and he also challenges them to design a camp gadget.

videos.title: Outsiders
videos.description: Tempers flare as the comedians take pot shots at one another during a hunting challenge, but they come together to in an effort to convert David Mitchell to their whacky new religion.
